# @native-dev-kit/react-native-liquid-glass

> Liquid Glass screens for React Native (New Architecture, React Native CLI). 22 whole native screens: SwiftUI with real Liquid Glass on iOS 27+, Jetpack Compose on Android 8+ (compileSdk 37) drawn with a glass engine or Material 3. Not building blocks: no GlassView or GlassButton, and screens take no children. One `GlassSettingsProvider` sets appearance, tint, layout direction, fonts, icons and the Android options for every screen. Expo is not supported yet.

Key rules: give every screen `style={{ flex: 1 }}`; hide the navigator header; wire Home's `onOpen` to `navigation.navigate(id)` and each screen's `onBack` to `navigation.goBack`; feed Home's `onSettingsChange` back into the provider and memoise its `value`; on iOS `appearance` is window-wide.

## Agent context

- [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): how the library works inside, by subsystem, with file paths, the exact API, the rules, the gotchas and how to build and verify
- [USAGE.md](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/USAGE.md): every component in plain language, with a sample, screenshots per platform and animations
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/skills/react-native-liquid-glass/SKILL.md): install and use steps

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/README.md): overview, requirements, install, quick start, the 22 screens, known issues
- [Getting started](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install and iOS/Android setup, first screen
- [iOS](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/ios.md): setup and iOS-specific behaviour (window-wide appearance, status bar, fonts, icons, RTL)
- [Android](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/android.md): setup and Android-specific behaviour (back key, glass or Material, bar icons, fonts, icons, RTL)
- [Screens](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/screens.md): every component, its bar title, props and events, GLASS_SCREENS
- [Settings](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/settings.md): GlassSettingsProvider, every setting with its default, which platform reads it, appearance and tint behaviour
- [React Navigation](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/react-navigation.md): the native-stack recipe with all screens, back handling, status bar
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): blank screens, settings that do not stick, window-wide appearance on iOS, Android back key, icons and fonts that do not show, build errors

## Optional

- [Layout direction](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/layout-direction.md): right-to-left on both platforms, RTL stack animations, the iOS 26 back-chevron workaround, known differences
- [Android style](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/android-style.md): Material 3 instead of glass on Android (`androidStyle`)
- [Control shapes](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/control-shapes.md): Android Material switches, sliders, top and bottom tabs as pill (default), labeled or glow (`androidControlShape`, `androidGlowIntensity`)
- [Fonts](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/fonts.md): custom fonts (`fontFamily`: one family or a font per weight)
- [Icons](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/docs/icons.md): custom icons keyed by SF Symbol name (`icons`, `vectorIcon`, SVG, images), the list of keys
- [Contributing](https://github.com/dev-mohamedabdelnaby/react-native-liquid-glass/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository layout and commands
